title: The Snore Collector
prompt: In a moonlit shared bedroom, the exhausted roommate catches a floating snore in a glass jar. Silence at last. Then the jar itself starts snoring.

shots.note: In the moonlight, the snorer's Z drifts toward the sleepless roommate. Their eyes track it.
A slow push toward the raised jar. A wandering Z drops into it. The lid snaps on.
Hold for the quiet beat. The jar buzzes; a giant Z pops from under its lid. Both roommates stare.
